# ANALYSIS: LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER

**Status:** Stage-1 backtest queued via autoresearch grinder harness. Awaiting completion.

## Hypothesis

We are running the Stage-1 backtest to obtain baseline edge_capture and P&L metrics for the LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER setup. This setup triggers on premarket price extremes (PML/PMH) that reverse intraday. The goal is to quantify its edge against J's anchor days and determine if it clears the OP-16 floor of 771 edge_capture.

## Mechanism

**Entry logic:** Long PUT if SPY opens below PML and reverses above PML within first 30 min of RTH; long CALL if opens above PMH and reverses below PMH. Entry = next bar open after reversal confirmation.  
**Exit logic:** Standard v15.3 rules: chart stop (reclaimed level ±$0.50 buffer), TP1 at +50% premium (2/3 qty), runner to breakeven after TP1, chandelier profit-lock trailing 15%, time stop 15:50 ET.  
**State:** Uses premarket level calculation from 04:00-09:29 ET SPY data. Requires PML/PMH to be defined (non-zero premarket bars).
